summary.text: Dan Cahill is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Essex District since 2016 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Cahill took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on May 18, 2016.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Public Safety and Homeland Security Joint Committee.
